Chief Economic Advisor Foresees Rupee Strength as FY28 Challenge

Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that India's challenge in the upcoming fiscal year (FY28) may stem from the rupee's strength, rather than its weakness, amidst ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. He indicated that two significant headwinds for India, namely energy prices and the absence of an "AI play," might be shifting in the country's favor. Nageswaran also commented on the narrowing difference between Indian and US bond yields, suggesting that the market should adapt to this situation.
